mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0 percent signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when FEDFUNDS < 2.0.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A U.S. unemployment rate exceeding 4.5 percent signals labor market weakness, prompting central bank stimulus and increased equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when UNRATE > 4.5.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth rate > 2.0%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%) indicate a 'Goldilocks' economic environment, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1_growth > 2.0 and CPIAUCSL < 2.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0%) increases cost of capital, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 (index 2017=100) signals robust manufacturing output and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when INDPRO > 105.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payroll increase exceeding 100,000 (PAYEMS_change > 100) indicates strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS_change > 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1,300 (thousands of units) indicate robust residential construction activity, supporting consumer confidence and economic growth, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days when HOUST > 1300.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST > 1350) and retail sales (RSAFS > 500,000) indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1350 and RSAFS > 500000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
